input: # Escapes that fail PARTIALLY, not completely. Every row above fails on its
# first digit, which parseInt reports as NaN, so they passed even while the
# lexer was decoding a prefix and walking past the rest. parseInt stops at the
# first non-digit and returns what it had, so `\u00st` decoded to U+0000 and
# then consumed the `s` and the `t` — data loss, and invisible to a corpus
# that only ever asked about escapes with no valid prefix at all. It also
# skips leading whitespace and honours a leading sign.
